name: Tariff Code Compliance
description: Tariff Code Compliance gives Claude read-only access to current tariff systems, exact versions, classification nodes, and graph evidence. Claude can ask for missing product facts, compare plausible HS and HTS codes, and explain the evidence, rejected alternatives, assumptions, and uncertainty behind a recommendation. The result is non-binding research support, not legal advice or a binding customs ruling; the user decides whether and how to use it.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Tariff Code Compliance to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Tariff Code Compliance to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.prod.tariffcodecompliance.com/tariff-code-compliance/v1/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Tariff Code Compliance MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Tariff Code Compliance provides these MCP tools: describe_tariff_system, get_node, list_node_edges, list_tariff_systems, resolve_nodes, search_nodes, and traverse_nodes.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Tariff Code Compliance?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Tariff Code Compliance in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.

_published_faq.name: Does Tariff Code Compliance MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Tariff Code Compliance requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Tariff Code Compliance is developed by Glasswaves, LLC. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
